Why answer is 10 not 4?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
^U|C does not mean ^(U|C), it means (^U)|C.
There are total 10 lines which either start with [Uu] or contain [Cc] somewhere in them.

I would recommend you to actually run these code snippets to get the clarity, as grep will automatically color the matches, clearing your doubts easily.
